title: Portfolio scale at three snapshots

coverage.note: Three snapshot quarters out of the 30 in-window quarters. Position and borrower counts come from the 31,067-row investment panel restricted to those same three quarters. NAV per share is derived as net_assets / shares_outstanding because the filed nav_per_share field is 90% null in this panel.
coverage.sentence: Computed on 3 of 30 quarter-panel rows (10.0% of the window panel). Three snapshot quarters out of the 30 in-window quarters. Position and borrower counts come from the 31,067-row investment panel restricted to those same three quarters. NAV per share is derived as net_assets / shares_outstanding because the filed nav_per_share field is 90% null in this panel.

source: Source: author's calculations on the ARCC BDC panel built from SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q filings.

values.units_note: usd_bn = billions of US dollars; mm = millions of shares; pct_change in percent
